FC Baranovichi or FC Baranavichy is a Belarusian professional football club based in Baranovichi (Baranavichy), Brest Oblast. Their home stadium is Lokomotiv (Lakamatyw) Stadium, Baranavichy. The club was founded in 1945 and had changed its name several times during its history. Team colors are red and blue.
